evidence.title: Reactix - Awesome React Native UI components free and open source built with Expo, Reanimated, Gesture Handler, and Skia.
GitHub - rit3zh/reacticx: Beautiful React Native components. One command away.

name: Reacticx
summary: 156 animated React Native components plus 19 screen blocks and 5 templates, copied into your project by a CLI.
description: Animated, gesture-driven components for React Native and Expo built on Reanimated, Skia and Gesture Handler, so motion runs on the UI thread. Nothing installs from npm: a CLI copies component source into your project. Ships 19 blocks (bottom sheets, empty states, settings, welcome screens), 5 templates and 96 docs pages; free and open source under MIT.
contains: 19 screen blocks: bottom sheets, empty states, settings, welcome screens
5 templates including chat, property detail, settings and 2 sign-up screens
CLI commands: init, add, list, info, diff, remove
shadcn-style registry and MCP server for coding agents
